sections.A: Heart failure mein dil jism ki zaroorat ke mutabiq khoon pump nahi kar pata. Yeh ek syndrome hai jis ki kai wajahein ho sakti hain.
sections.B: Mehnat par saans phoolna, lait kar saans ki takleef (takiye chahiye), raat ko saans ke liye jagna, thakan aur pairon ki sujan.
sections.C: Roz ka wazan (2-3 din mein 2 kg barhna paani ruka hone ka ishara), kitne takiye, aur kya dawayein badlin.
sections.D: Vital signs, SpO2, wazan, sujan, seene ki aawaz aur gardan ki nas (JVP).
sections.G: Aaraam mein saans phoolna, gulabi jhaag wala balgham aur seedha na let sakna (pulmonary oedema): emergency. Tezi se wazan barhna: medical team.
sections.H: Stable (haal mein bigra nahi, dawayein stable)? To supervised exercise training recommend hai.
sections.I: Aerobic exercise kam se shuru (RPE 11-13, 10-20 minute), dheere dheere barhayein, aur halki taaqat ki exercise.
sections.M: 6MWT, NYHA class, zindagi ka mayar, wazan ka rujhan aur sujan dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Stable heart failure mein supervised exercise mehfooz aur faida mand hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
